turns.teacher: Theek hai Gauri, aaj yahin stop karte hain. Tumne 7 aur 3 se 10 banana sahi dikhaya. Bye, teacher ko namaste!

end.parentNote: Gauri practised finding pairs that make 10. They correctly gave 7 and 3, using dance-step counting as an example. They mixed up 4+4 and 5+3 as pairs for 10; this was not corrected before stopping. At home, use small objects to build 10 and ask, “How many more?”
